Synchronise my vaults through this service

The cloud keeps one encrypted copy of each vault. KeyNexa downloads it, merges it with your local vault and uploads the result only when nothing else changed it, so two devices that are never on at the same time end up the same. The file is encrypted exactly like the copies: the service only sees the encrypted file. Older versions of an entry stay in its history, and deleting an entry on one device deletes it everywhere after the next synchronisation.
This service or bucket does not support the conditional writes synchronisation needs, so the switch stays off. Copies keep working. Some services, such as Backblaze B2, may not support them.

Once a day, KeyNexa asks GitHub for the newest version. Nothing else is sent, apart from the app version; GitHub sees your IP address. It installs a new version only after you agree, and only if the project signed it.

KeyNexa can ask GitHub once a day whether there is a newer version. It installs one only after you agree, and only if the project signed it. Nothing else is sent. You can change this in Settings.
